articles.summary: This week, we reported our fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial results, finishing up a strong year for Sportradar by virtually every measure. Total revenue reached a record €1,290 million, up 17% year-over-year, driven by strong performance across both our Betting Technology & Solutions products and Sports Content, Technology & Services products. articles.summary: ST. GALLEN, Switzerland, March 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sportradar Group AG (Nasdaq: SRAD) (the “Company”) today announced that it filed its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 27, 2026.
